summary: Athena Technology Acquisition Corp. II (Athena) filed an 8-K to disclose a Second Amendment to its Business Combination Agreement (BCA) with Ace Green Recycling, Inc., increasing authorized preferred shares from 1,000,000 to 5,000,000 to facilitate a $32M PIPE investment. On April 21, 2026, Athena and Ace Green entered into securities purchase agreements with investors for 3,333,333 shares of 12.0% Series A Cumulative Convertible Preferred Stock (convertible at $12.00/sh) and warrants for 5,000,000 common shares (exercise price $12.00/sh), plus 1,000,000 common shares as additional consideration. Closing occurs concurrent with the business combination subject to listing approval. No advisor named. Watch: stockholder vote, redemption dynamics, and listing qualification risk.
